note: Length Indicator is a widget-enhancement module with no field type, no widget of its own, no settings form, no configure route (configure=null), no permissions, no Drush, and no plugins. Its entire persistent state is a per-component third-party setting on a core text widget inside an entity_form_display config entity: content.<field>.third_party_settings.length_indicator with indicator:true and indicator_opt:{optimin,optimax,tolerance}. The checkbox is only offered on the string_textfield and string_textarea widgets (see _length_indicator_widget_is_supported). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real config: introspection reads back which field has the setting; execution creates a string (or string_long) field on Article and enables the indicator, verified against the live entity_form_display.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module length_indicator, on which field widgets does the 'Length indicator' option appear? Does it work on a CKEditor/formatted-text field?
evals.expected_output: The option is added by hook_field_widget_third_party_settings_form() only for the supported widgets checked in _length_indicator_widget_is_supported(): string_textfield (Textfield) and string_textarea (Text area, multiple rows). It does not appear on formatted-text widgets like text_textarea (CKEditor) or any other widget.

evals.prompt: What numeric settings does the length_indicator module let you configure per field, and what constraints apply between them?
evals.expected_output: Three numbers: Optimum minimum (optimin), Optimum maximum (optimax) and Tolerance. Constraints enforced on the widget settings form: optimax must be greater than optimin, and tolerance must be smaller than optimin.

evals.prompt: I enabled length_indicator on a Drupal 11 site but there is no admin settings page for it. How do I turn the length indicator on for a specific text field, and where is that choice stored?
evals.expected_output: There is no configure route (configure=null). Open the entity's Manage form display, click the text field's widget cog, tick 'Length indicator', set Optimum minimum/maximum and Tolerance, Update and Save. It is stored as a third-party setting on that field's component: core.entity_form_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field>.third_party_settings.length_indicator.indicator: true (plus indicator_opt).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has one text field whose widget has the length_indicator enabled. Inspect the live default form display for Article and give the machine name of that field.
evals.expected_output: The field is field_li_known: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its string_textfield component has third_party_settings.length_indicator.indicator: true (indicator_opt optimin 40 / optimax 60 / tolerance 10).

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two text fields, field_li_on and field_li_off. Exactly one of them has the length_indicator turned on for its edit widget. Inspect the live form-display configuration and state which field has the length indicator enabled.
evals.expected_output: field_li_on has the indicator: in core.entity_form_display.node.article.default its component has third_party_settings.length_indicator.indicator: true, whereas field_li_off has no length_indicator setting.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a text field field_li_task using the Textfield (string_textfield) widget. Using the length_indicator module, turn on the length indicator for this field's widget on the default form display, with Optimum minimum 50, Optimum maximum 70 and Tolerance 8. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_li_task component carries third_party_settings.length_indicator.indicator: true with indicator_opt optimin=50, optimax=70, tolerance=8 (set the component's third_party_settings and save, or tick 'Length indicator' on the widget in Manage form display).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a plain-text-long field field_li_area using the 'Text area (multiple rows)' (string_textarea) widget. Use the length_indicator module to enable the length indicator on this widget in the default form display, with an optimum range of about 120 to 160 characters and a tolerance of 20. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_li_area component (widget string_textarea) carries third_party_settings.length_indicator.indicator: true with an indicator_opt whose optimax > optimin (e.g. optimin 120, optimax 160, tolerance 20).
